name: Yes, Your Highness
source:
This is Himawari’s debut title. A war had continued for a long long time in a certain country. With peace and order lost, it was no longer the happiest country in the world and poor people filled the streets. It had become difficult for people to see hope in their futures. At that time, Munakata was called the hero of the country – never having suffered a defeat in any battle. The new post which was bestowed upon him was not in the blood-stained and mud-caked battlefield, but rather in a faintly-fragrant and extravagantly-decorated mansion. His duty was to protect the royal princess Sakurako while she spends her days sheltered away from the outside world.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是向日葵的首张作品。某个国家的战争已经持续了很长时间。随着和平与秩序的丧失，它不再是世界上最幸福的国家，街道上挤满了穷人。人们很难看到未来的希望。当时，宗像被称为国家的英雄——在任何战斗中都没有失败过。授予他的新职务，并不是在血迹斑斑、泥泞不堪的战场上，而是在一座幽香缭绕、金碧辉煌的府邸里。他的职责是保护皇室公主樱子，让她度过与外界隔绝的日子。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
